# KD Pressing

> KD Pressing is a sheet metal pressing company in Waluj MIDC, Aurangabad, Maharashtra, India. Established in February 2017, it manufactures sheet metal components and sub assemblies for the automotive industry from a 5,000 sq ft facility. Tagline: Quality. Assured.

Key facts:
- Presses: 22 mechanical power presses, 10 ton to 150 ton
- Shearing: 1525 mm x 4 mm shearing machine, manual decoiler
- Sub assembly: drilling, orbital riveting, inverter-base CO2 welding, surface grinding (projection and spot welding planned)
- Quality: UTM, hardness tester, CMM, Baker micrometer, vernier and height gauge, 5S
- Customers: Tier-II vendors of the BAL cluster, including Sakshi Industries, Shree Saigan Industries, Om Auto Comp's, Baba Engineers
- Contact: corporate@kdpressing.com, +91 99708 43177, +91 99222 22088
- Address: Plot No 09, GUT No. 23, Sai Udyog Nagari, Behind Cosmo Films, Kamlapur Village, MIDC Area, Waluj, Aurangabad 431 136
